description: Renamed from status-mark: install status and import Status, StatusMedia (was StatusMarkDot) and StatusName (was StatusMarkLabel) from @/components/status. Adds StatusDescription, one muted line after the name. The ring width token is now --status-media-ring.
The docs link to this item's playground page at /playground/components/status-mark.
Assessed against the lifecycle criteria: beta. Its design critique is not yet clean: in forced-colours mode the in-review and approved dots look the same (issue #41).
Installs into your components folder, so import it from @/components.
Merges class names with the cn item, so a className override replaces a token utility.
Takes its ring width from the tokens item.
